lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The amendment is read at forty past the hour to a chamber that is mostly empty and entirely bought. It carries by three votes, because three people were bored and voting is the quickest way out of a chamber.

lines.speaker: mara_vesely
lines.text: A cession must name its beneficiary. Twelve words. Not one person in this room understands what they have just made impossible, and I am not going to be the one who explains it to them.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century the Steward's charter has an owner clause that nobody has ever been able to source. That was it. That was this. That was you, at twenty to eleven, on a Thursday.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Twelve words. Two hundred and forty-eight years. I'm going to need a minute with that and I'd rather have it outside.
